data.name: Query_GetDataForGateEntry
data.value:
Select
[Gate_OutwardDetail].CompanyID, [Gate_OutwardDetail].PeriodID,
[Gate_OutwardHeader].DocumentTypeID, [Gate_OutwardDetail].[Gate_OutwardDetailID], [Gate_OutwardDetail].[Gate_OutwardHeaderID], INV_Item.ItemID, [INV_Item].[Description] , INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, [Gate_OutwardDetail].TransactionUOMID, [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMName], [Gate_OutwardDetail].[TransactionQuantity], '' AS [Action], INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SerialNo from [Gate_OutwardDetail] inner join INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = [Gate_OutwardDetail].ItemID --and INV_Item.CompanyID=[Gate_OutwardDetail].CompanyID INNER JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [Gate_OutwardDetail].TransactionUOMID AND [SET_UnitofMeasure].[Status] = 1 inner join [Gate_OutwardHeader] on [Gate_OutwardHeader].Gate_OutwardHeaderID = Gate_OutwardDetail.gate_OutwardHeaderID and [Gate_OutwardHeader].CompanyID = Gate_OutwardDetail.CompanyID and [Gate_OutwardHeader].PeriodID = Gate_OutwardDetail.PeriodID INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = [Gate_OutwardDetail].[Gate_OutwardHeaderID] AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID = [Gate_OutwardDetail].[Gate_OutwardDetailID] and INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = Gate_OutwardDetail.CompanyID and INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = Gate_OutwardDetail.PeriodID
Where Gate_OutwardDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and Gate_OutwardDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID and [Gate_OutwardDetail].Status = 1 AND Gate_OutwardDetail.Gate_OutwardHeaderID = @Gate_OutwardHeaderID

data.name: Query_GetDataForPRNReport
data.value: Select INV_Item.Description ItemDescription, INV_Item.ItemID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity TransactionQuantity, ((INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * 50) / 1000) TransactionQuantityMT, INV_StockTransactionHeader.BatchID, Set_Batch.Description BatchDescription, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, isnull([INV_StockTransactionDetail].QualityID,0) as QualityID, ISNULL(SET_Quality.QualityName, 'Unknown') as QualityName, 'OnDate' [Type] From INV_StockTransactionHeader inner JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID inner JOIN SET_Batch on Set_Batch.BatchID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.BatchID --AND Set_Batch.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_Batch.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID JOIN INV_Item on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID LEFT JOIN [SET_Quality] ON [SET_Quality].[QualityID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[QualityID] Where INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND (INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID = @ItemID OR @ItemID Is NULL) AND (INV_StockTransactionHeader.BatchID = @BatchID OR @BatchID Is Null) AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID in ( select DocumentTypeID from Set_DocumentType where menuID in ( SELECT [MenuID] FROM ApplicationMenu WHERE MenuPath = @MenuPath ) AND CompanyID = @CompanyID AND PeriodID = @PeriodID AND Status = 1 AND IsActive = 1 ) --AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[QualityID] = @QualityID {0} GROUP BY INV_Item.Description, INV_Item.ItemID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.BatchID, Set_Batch.Description, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity, [INV_StockTransactionDetail].QualityID, SET_Quality.QualityName, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate Order By INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate
